description: Single source of truth for cause ranking arithmetic, confidence propagation, dissent measurement, and conflict handling. The Cause Ranker engine MUST NOT reimplement these formulas — it reads them from this file and applies them.

rankingModel.formula: posterior(c) = softmax_temp( logScore(c) ) where logScore(c) = log(prior(c)) + sum_p activation(p) * llr(c|p) + sum_s confidence(s) * llr(c|s) - conflictPenalty(c) - dissentDampener(c)
rankingModel.rationale: Causes are MUTUALLY-COMPETITIVE EXPLANATIONS — a softmax over Bayesian log-scores is correct because (a) probability mass is conserved across the 10 causes, (b) log-additive combination of independent evidence streams (pathways + signals) is the well-formed Naive-Bayes update, and (c) softmax provides a continuous, differentiable surface for downstream confidence reasoning rather than the discontinuous step-functions of a rule-based selector.
rankingModel.temperatureRationale: Temperature 1.00 keeps posteriors interpretable as probabilities. Lower temperatures over-sharpen (one cause dominates regardless of evidence quality); higher temperatures flatten the distribution and obscure leadership. Locked at 1.0 for v1.

steps.name: Inherit Pathway Graph
steps.operation: Load PathwayGraph emitted by Pathway Activation Engine. Read each pathway's activation, confidence, severity, severityBand, subthreshold flag. Subthreshold pathways (activation < 0.20) do not contribute to cause scoring.

steps.name: Inherit Direct Signals
steps.operation: Load present signals (from Signal Registry post-extraction) with their confidence and evidenceTier. Subthreshold signals (confidence < 0.20) do not contribute to cause scoring.

steps.name: Compute Per-Cause Log Score
steps.operation: For each cause c: logScore(c) = log(priorProbability(c)) + sum over contributingPathways[p] of activation(p) * llr(c|p) + sum over contributingSignals[s] of confidence(s) * llr(c|s). Pathways and signals below their minActivation/minConfidence threshold contribute zero.

steps.name: Apply Conflict Penalty
steps.operation: For each cause c, count present signals with role=='conflicting' AND confidence >= conflictThreshold AND pathways with role=='exclusionary' with activation >= conflictThreshold. logScore(c) -= conflictCount * conflictPenaltyMagnitude. This penalises causes whose presence is contradicted by present evidence — distinct from absence of supporting evidence.

steps.name: Apply Evidence-Tier Floor
steps.operation: If the dominant supporting evidence for cause c is heuristic-tier only, logScore(c) -= heuristicFloorPenalty. If emerging-tier only, logScore(c) -= emergingFloorPenalty. Established-tier evidence applies no penalty.

steps.name: Compute Composite Promotion (multifactorial-hair-loss only)
steps.operation: Count pathways with activation >= compositeRule.minimumPathwayActivation. If count >= compositeRule.minimumActivePathways AND the gap between the top-two single-cause posteriors (computed without composite) is < compositeRule.minimumDissentBetweenTopTwoCauses, add compositePromotionBoost to multifactorial logScore.

steps.name: Normalise via Softmax
steps.operation: posterior(c) = exp(logScore(c) / temperature) / sum_k exp(logScore(k) / temperature). For numerical stability subtract maxLog before exponentiation.

steps.name: Compute Dissent
steps.operation: Sort causes by posterior descending. dissent(c_top) = posterior(c_2nd). leadershipMargin = posterior(c_top) - posterior(c_2nd). If leadershipMargin < dissentRules[c_top].maxDissentForLead, the cause is flagged as co-leading rather than leading.

steps.name: Compute Per-Cause Confidence (separate from posterior)
steps.operation: confidence(c) = posteriorMass(c) * evidenceTierFloor(c) * conflictMassDampener(c) * propagatedPathwayConfidence(c). Bounded by [minCauseConfidence, maxCauseConfidence]. See confidencePropagation section.

steps.name: Emit Top-N
steps.operation: Return top topNDefault causes ordered by posterior descending. Always include co-leads (within maxDissentForLead). Always include multifactorial-hair-loss if its compositeRule fired.

rankingModel.determinism: Steps must execute in the order above. Two evaluations of the same PathwayGraph + same signal set against the same registry versions must yield byte-identical CauseRank output. Floating-point arithmetic is performed at IEEE 754 double precision; rounding for emission happens once at serialisation using bankers'-rounding to four decimal places. Ties in posterior are broken first by lower priorProbability (less-favoured prior wins to reward evidence), then by lexicographic cause id, ensuring deterministic ordering.

confidencePropagation.description: Cause confidence is DISTINCT from cause posterior. Posterior = 'how probable this cause is given evidence'. Confidence = 'how trustworthy that posterior is given the evidence base'. A cause can be probable yet low-confidence if its evidence is heuristic-tier or sparse.
confidencePropagation.formula: confidence(c) = clip( posterior(c) * tierFloor(c) * (1 - conflictMass(c)) * pathwayConfidenceAvg(c), [minCauseConfidence, maxCauseConfidence] )

tierFloor.rule: tierFloor(c) = worst tier among the cause's PRIMARY-role evidence references (pathways + signals).

conflictMass.description: Fraction of total contributing weight that is currently being subtracted by conflicting evidence.
conflictMass.formula: conflictMass(c) = sum_conflicting weight * conf / (sum_supporting weight * conf + sum_conflicting weight * conf)

pathwayConfidenceAvg.description: Weighted average of contributing pathway confidences (Pathway Registry confidence(p), not activation(p)).
pathwayConfidenceAvg.formula: pathwayConfidenceAvg(c) = sum_p activation(p) * confidence(p) / sum_p activation(p)  (over pathways with activation >= 0.20)

dissentModel.description: Dissent measures how much the second-best cause challenges the first. High dissent prevents single-cause framing.

decisionTable.uiHandling: Multifactorial framing surfacing top-3 contributing causes.

conflictHandling.description: Conflicting evidence is treated SUBTRACTIVELY (penalty) rather than EXCLUSIONARILY (zeroing), except for evidence with role=='exclusionary' which sets logScore(c) to -infinity when its threshold is crossed.
conflictHandling.rationale: True exclusions reflect anatomical incompatibility, not weak counter-evidence. We never zero out a cause for a single low-confidence conflicting signal — we penalise it. Only patterns clinically incompatible with the cause are exclusionary.

dissentTracking.description: Every CauseRank must carry the full dissent vector for audit reconstruction and explainability narration. Dissent is not summary — it is structural.

subthresholdHandling.description: Causes with posterior below subthresholdPosterior are emitted as 'considered' but not ranked in the top-N. They appear in the CauseGraph for transparency but do not drive downstream recommendations.
subthresholdHandling.label: considered

governanceConstraints: All log-likelihood ratios (llr) in registry.json must be in [-3.0, 3.0]. Positive => evidence supports the cause; negative => evidence opposes.

Sum of |llr| for primary-role evidence per cause must be in [3.0, 18.0]. Below 3.0 the cause has no decisive evidence; above 18.0 the cause is over-fitted to its evidence set and risks dominance regardless of pathway state.
Every cause must declare at least one role=='primary' pathway AND at least one role=='primary' signal — except multifactorial-hair-loss, which is composite by definition.
Any change to the ranking formula, softmax temperature, conflict penalty, or compositePromotionBoost requires major version bump + full parity fixture regeneration + clinical-reviewer sign-off.

priorProbabilities across the 10 causes must sum to a value in [0.85, 1.05]. (Not strictly normalised because priors are clinical base-rate estimates, not over the 10-cause partition; gentle bound protects against authoring errors.)
evidenceTier on the cause itself MUST be the WORST tier among its declared primary-role evidence (pathways + signals).

productionScaleTargets.notes: 10 causes × ≤20 pathway/signal references each + softmax over 10 values + dissent computation. Bounded compute, no I/O after registry load. Stateless and trivially horizontally scalable.
